units.source_text: 当我问他为什么现在来征求我的看法时，

en.t: When I asked him why he had come to ask for my opinion now,

units.source_text: 他说：‘我是个懦夫，深感羞愧。’他的语气从未如此沮丧。

en.t: he said, 'I am a coward, and I am deeply ashamed.' His tone had never been so dejected.

units.source_text: 他还说：‘因为犹豫不决，怎么也拿不定主意，只好来征求一下你的意见。’

en.t: He also said, 'Because I cannot stop wavering and cannot make up my mind at all, I had no choice but to come and ask your opinion.'

units.source_text: 我不失时机地追问他：‘犹豫不决什么？’

en.t: I seized the moment and pressed him, 'Wavering about what?'

units.source_text: 他说：‘不知是应该前进还是后退。’

en.t: He said, 'I do not know whether I should go forward or draw back.'

units.source_text: 我又追问道：‘如果后退，你能做到吗？’

en.t: I pressed him again, 'If you were to draw back, could you do it?'

units.source_text: 结果他答不上来了，只是说：‘很痛苦。’

en.t: In the end he could not answer, and only said, 'It is painful.'

units.source_text: 他的神情一看便知，确实是很痛苦。

en.t: One look at his expression made it clear that he truly was in pain.

units.source_text: 倘若对方不是小姐的话，我一定会让他久旱逢甘露一般，得到一个最渴求的回答。

en.t: If the person in question had not been the young lady, I would surely have given him the answer he longed for most, like sweet rain after a long drought.

units.source_text: 我相信，自己生来就是具有这般慈悲心的人，但是，那时的我却没有这样做。

en.t: I believe I was born with that kind of compassion, but at that time I did not act on it.
